provinceDeepAtlasProfile.oneLine: Jor’maelis is centered at -46.374220, 130.627031 under Communalism, with 105,431,000 people across 13 settlements.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.extremeAtlasDescription: Jor’maelis occupies 10,194,632.18 sq mi / 26,403,976.13 sq km of modeled Earth-sized territory, about 5.176582% of Belavadös's surface. It is not merely a province but a continent-scale civic machine: Underwater without reefs, Beach and grass with water and Partial forest define its broad terrain, while its settlements intensify into Ocean Surface floating settlement, Beach and grass with water, Underwater without reefs, Partial forest and Farming. Population density is 3.993 people/sq km / 10.342 people/sq mi, which lets wilderness, roads, faction-held corridors, and vast uncrowded borders remain huge.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.peopleFactionsAndFaith: The strongest public people-groups are Humans, Near-Humans, and Mixed Heritage, Halfling and Smallfolk, Animalfolk and Mammalian Anthropomorphs, Elf Parent Race and Elf Bloodlines, Amphibious and Aquatic Peoples, Elemental and Energy-Born Peoples, and 2 more. Frequently recorded peoples include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Triton, Merfolk, Elf — Sea Elf, Tortle, Genasi — Water Genasi, Hadozee, and 4 more. Faction visibility leans toward The Nefaric Veil, with worship and patronage records naming Nefarokir, Eirzunet, Nebyrr, Ishtanora, Iskareth, Sigrananna, Bastveig, and 3 more.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.groupLinkDescription: The province participates in 6 recorded four-province geography group links, including 5 cross-transportation-group links. npcs.name: Nikol Vellum
npcs.description:
Nikol Vellum is a dry, principled Relicborn detective with a battered coat, a sharper mind than most magistrates, and the uncomfortable habit of treating every missing person as if the world itself owes them an answer. As one of Setrimir’s artificial lineages, they/he carries fragmented histories inside their body, leaving them caught between borrowed memory, awakened purpose, and the stubborn choice to become more than the relic they were made from.
From the Brass Concordat Detective Office, Nikol investigates disappearances, false identities, inheritance fraud, memory tampering, and old crimes buried beneath Jor’maelis’ civic paperwork and transit ledgers. They/he is snarky, compassionate, self-loathing in quiet moments, and fiercely protective of anyone treated like a thing instead of a person.
npcs.settlementAndAncestryTexture: Nyr'thalor is a Village in Jor’maelis, under Communalism, with low danger, Beach and grass with water, Partial forest, Beach and reefs with water terrain. Local records favor Altruistic, Neutral, Cooperative, Neutral civic habits; common communities include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Elf — Wood Elf, Elf — Eladrin, Fey-Folk — Faerie. Relicborn reads through the Relicborn entry of the race compendium, within Constructed and Artificial Beings, marked by Setrimir. Constructs awakened from ancient artifacts or forgotten relic systems, Relicborn carry fragmented histories within their forms. They are enigmatic and often driven by buried purpose. Table cues: Dance of Death, Eternal Party, Moment of Remembrance, Soul of Revelry; starting tendency Neutral - Lawful - Cooperative - Honorable.
rumors: Nikol Vellum knows why an ichor ledger changed hands last Enkirday.
Nikol Vellum has a contact in Wagriolyn who will deny everything.
plotHooks: Nikol Vellum asks the party to protect a household member without revealing why.
A rival faction offers proof that Nikol Vellum's public story is incomplete.
